title: Car Crash Analysis Dashboard
description:
Insights of the analyzing: Here are the most big significant of accident causes: Unfortunatly most of people get distraction while drive which increase the accident. Moreover, It’s notice that sedan, station wagon or sport utility vehicle getting accidents more than the other types of vehicle. Also, Brooklyn_west, Queens_outer, Brooklyn_East, Manhattan_Midtown provinces are the most crashed areas. The winter season have the most rate of crashed happen through the year. 
 The same insight we are getting through changing the peak or Peak_off hours except the summer season have higher accident in off_peak hours than the peak hours. The total people killed because of the accident belong the year are 640 and 125 people get injured while it’s notice that people get injured or killed because of accident in Peak_off hours more higher than peak hours.
result: Figured out the most significant causes of car crashes and provided insights on how to prevent them.

title: Real-Time Object Detection System
description: Developing a lightweight object detection system for retail inventory management using YOLOv8 and webcam feed integration.
approach: Fine-tuned YOLOv8 on custom dataset. Implemented tracking and counting logic.
result: Achieved 92% mAP on test set with 30 FPS inference speed on edge device.

title: Hybrid Learning: CNN + SVM
description: Experimental comparison of end-to-end Deep Learning vs. feature extraction (CNN) fed into classical classifiers (SVM/RF).
approach: Extracted features from ResNet50. Trained scikit-learn classifiers on embeddings.
result: Hybrid model outperformed standard CNN by 2% on small dataset regime (Medical Imaging).

title: AI Agent Orchestrator
description: A workflow system where multiple LLM agents collaborate to summarize news and generate social media content automatically.
approach: LangChain for orchestration. OpenAI API for reasoning. Telegram bot for delivery.
result: Automated daily tech news digest generation with zero human intervention.
